title: Break of the stalking range
thesis_summary: Synthetic H1 long marked HUNT. Price swept the stalking-range low and displaced back through the range high. The fixture records a trigger. It does not record an entry fill.

evidence.label: Stalking-range sweep
evidence.detail: The range low was taken before the displacement candle.

evidence.label: Displacement
evidence.detail: The trigger candle closed through the stalking-range high.

evidence.label: Sweep extreme
evidence.detail: A close beyond the sweep extreme ends the long.

disclaimer: Synthetic training fixture. Not a live CCI setup. The Pack does not execute trades and does not promise profit.
